# Third-party browser assets

Self-hosted, exact npm distribution files; no CDN or Node process needed in Production.

| Asset | npm package | License |
|---|---|---|
| htmx-2.0.8.min.js | htmx.org@2.0.8 | Zero-Clause BSD |
| alpine-3.14.9.min.js | alpinejs@3.14.9 | MIT |

License texts are stored alongside the files. htmx supports partial status/probe updates;
Alpine controls mobile navigation, profile disclosure and optional theme switching.
No financial values, credentials, cookies or signals are placed in localStorage.
Only the appearance preference `cs-theme` is stored there.
